description: This file defines a class 'VersionAwarePlacementDirector' implementing the 'IPlacementDirector' interface, responsible for determining the silo placement for an activation based on version compatibility within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: VersionAwarePlacementDirector
classes.description: Custom placement director for choosing silos based on the interface version, aiming to place activations in silos with the maximum number of compatible silos for a given version.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Determines the target silo for a new activation based on interface version compatibility, selecting either the list of compatible silos or the version with the most silos.
